name: OpenWrt Router Monitor
description: Read-only OpenWrt telemetry via companion collector
template: <Stack gap="sm"><Group justify="space-between"><Text fw={700}>OpenWrt Router & WAN</Text><RefreshButton requestId="snapshot" size="xs" /></Group>{status.snapshot?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red">Collector unavailable</Alert> : !data.snapshot ? <Text>Waiting for data...</Text> : <Stack gap="xs"><Text size="sm">{data.snapshot.router?.model || "Router not connected"}</Text><Text size="xs">{data.snapshot.router?.release || "Firmware unknown"}</Text><Badge color={data.snapshot.wan?.up ? "green" : "gray"}>{data.snapshot.wan?.up ? "WAN UP" : "WAN UNKNOWN / DOWN"}</Badge><Text size="sm">Uptime: {data.snapshot.router?.uptime ?? "N/A"} seconds</Text><Text size="xs">WAN changes: {data.snapshot.wanEvents?.length ?? 0} recorded</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{data.snapshot.errors?.join("; ") || "No polling errors"}</Text></Stack>}</Stack>
